## Context

Describe the verified problem, constraints, and why a durable decision is needed.
Distinguish scientific requirements from repository or dependency limitations.

## Decision

State the selected behavior precisely. Include formulas, values, interfaces,
fallbacks, compatibility, or experimental effects when applicable.

## Alternatives Considered

| Alternative | Benefits | Drawbacks | Reason not selected |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | | | |

## Consequences

Describe scientific validity, architecture, compatibility, reproducibility,
migration, operational cost, and risks.

## Validation And Traceability

List affected requirement IDs, acceptance criteria, mandatory tests, and any
new regression risk.

- Approved by: `<name or role>`
